note: General training guidance, not a diagnosis. If it isn't clearly improving within two weeks, see a physiotherapist.
stop_text: See a doctor or physio before training this area. Tap 'I've been checked' when you have.
emergency_text: Stop now and get medical help. Chest pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness while training needs a doctor today, not injury mode.
warm_up_tip: That sounds like normal training soreness: dull, spread across the muscle, often on both sides, 12–48 hours after training, and it eases as you warm up. Train as normal with a longer warm-up: 5 more minutes of easy cardio and two extra light sets of your first lift.
sick_rule: Symptoms only above the neck, like a runny nose or a mild sore throat: train lighter or do the minimum session. Fever, chest congestion, a stomach bug, body aches or real fatigue: rest, and the day is excused. If you might be contagious, stay out of the shared office gym.

red_flags.text: Swelling or bruising that appeared quickly
Numbness, tingling, or pain shooting down a limb
Can't put weight on it or lift the limb
Pain at night or at rest
A sudden pop with bruising in the chest or the front of the upper arm (can be a torn tendon: see a doctor quickly)

emergency.text: Chest pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness while training

areas.label: Shoulder
areas.taken_out: Overhead press, dips, wide-grip bench, upright rows
areas.instead: Neutral-grip dumbbell or machine press over a shorter range, cable rows, external-rotation work, lateral raises only if painless

areas.label: Elbow
areas.taken_out: Heavy curls, skull crushers, pull-ups, close-grip pressing
areas.instead: Straps for pulling, neutral grips, lighter high-rep arm work, wrist holds

areas.label: Wrist
areas.taken_out: Barbell pressing, push-ups on flat palms, front squats
areas.instead: Machines with neutral handles, push-ups on fists or handles, straps

areas.label: Lower back
areas.taken_out: Barbell rows, Romanian deadlifts, back squats, standing overhead press, sit-ups
areas.instead: Chest-supported rows, leg press at moderate depth, leg curl and extension, hip thrust if painless, curl-ups, side planks, bird dogs, walking
areas.keeps: Upper body on machines or with chest support

areas.label: Knee
areas.taken_out: Deep squats, lunges, heavy leg extensions, jumping
areas.instead: Box squat to a pain-free depth, partial-range leg press, Romanian deadlift, hip thrust, leg curl, wall-sit holds, cycling

areas.label: Hip
areas.taken_out: Deep squats, deep leg press, lunges, wide stances
areas.instead: Higher box squat, hip thrust or glute bridge if painless, leg extension and curl

areas.label: Ankle
areas.instead: Seated calf raise if painless, leg extension and curl, seated exercises

areas.label: Neck
areas.taken_out: Shrugs, heavy overhead work, heavy carries
areas.instead: Supported and machine exercises with your head kept neutral

areas.label: A strained muscle
areas.taken_out: Heavy and deep-stretch work for that muscle
areas.instead: Light holds, then light full-range sets, building back as pain allows
